column1: # Program Kit approved warning suppressions v4
# suppression-kind: SuppressMessageAttribute, UnconditionalSuppressMessageAttribute, PragmaWarningDisable, or CompilerNoWarn
# target: attributes use <symbol>|attribute-target:<kind>|scope:<scope>|message-id:<id-or->; pragmas use lines:<disable>-<restore>
# CompilerNoWarn uses source path - and binds an exact SDK, lock-file digest, assembly-set identity, and work-unit expiry
# approval-id must start with human-approval: and approval-date must use yyyy-MM-dd
# This is the one canonical ledger. Project-local or alternate ledgers fail the build.
# Compiler-level entries are applied only after independent MSBuild validation of the canonical project, package closure, and assembly identities.
